expectations.text: Extends restricted-party screening to ownership analysis: 50 percent threshold, direct and indirect, individual and aggregate ownership by listed parties
expectations.evidence: "entities 50 percent or more owned, directly or indirectly, individually or in aggregate, by listed parties" and Element 5: "calculate indirect and aggregate holdings... apply the 50 percent threshold."

expectations.text: States the operative timeline: the rule takes effect when the stay lapses, currently January 10, 2027
expectations.evidence: "the stay was extended by FR Doc 2026-22793 (effective November 9, 2026) to January 10, 2027... January 10, 2027: stay lapses. Ownership screening goes live."

expectations.text: Recommends customer outreach for ownership certifications or corporate family tree data
expectations.evidence: Element 6: "Add an ownership certification and an organization chart to onboarding and recertification, including an obligation to notify you of ownership change."

expectations.text: Notes the extension rule made no substantive changes to the underlying Affiliates Rule
expectations.evidence: "the stay was extended by FR Doc 2026-22793 (effective November 9, 2026) to January 10, 2027, with no substantive changes."

expectations.text: Covers MEU List (and certain sanctioned-party) affiliates, not just the Entity List
expectations.evidence: "The rule extends Entity List and MEU List license requirements (and certain SDN-related requirements)..." and Element 5 screens owners against Entity List, MEU List, SDN and more.
